jobs.title: Financial Reporting Consolidation Team Lead
jobs.description: The Financial Reporting Consolidation Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the group-wide financial consolidation process, ensuring accurate and timely consolidated financial statements in compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and company policies. The role leads intercompany eliminations, currency translations, minority interest calculations, and statutory, regulatory, and management reporting, while coordinating group audit requirements to ensure the integrity and accuracy of consolidated financial records. What You'll Do: Oversee the end-to-end monthly, quarterly, and annual financial consolidation process, prepare complete sets of consolidated financial statements, and execute consolidation activities (including transport of schedules to server, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translations, and equity/non-controlling interest adjustments) Ensure group-wide accounting records, subsidiary submissions, and consolidated financial data are complete, accurate, and compliant with company policies, applicable accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP), and regulatory/statutory requirements. Coordinate and support internal and external group audit activities by ensuring timely responses to audit inquiries and providing consolidated schedules, elimination reconciliations, and supporting documents. Identify opportunities to streamline the close and consolidation timeline, enhance data integrity across entities, and lead the implementation of system and process efficiency initiatives. Lead the training, coaching, and mentoring of Consolidation and Financial Reporting Analysts.

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients. That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite. SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily. We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care. We're a small team by design. No layers, no approvals queue, no "let's circle back." You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.

The role involves physical inventory verification, transaction testing, reconciliation of inventory records, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions to minimize discrepancies and operational risks. Key Responsibilities: Conduct regular physical inventory counts and verify actual stocks against Oracle/ERP system records. Audit receiving, storage, issuance, production returns, and dispatch transactions. Review and validate supporting documents, inventory records, and warehouse transactions. Investigate inventory discrepancies, including shortages, overages, unrecorded items, and recurring variances. Monitor the movement and accountability of raw materials, packaging materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and spare parts. Evaluate warehouse documentation, system records, authorization, and compliance with established procedures. Identify operational risks, control weaknesses, and potential inventory losses. Monitor corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Prepare clear and accurate audit reports with findings and recommendations. Coordinate with warehouse, production, and other departments regarding audit findings and follow-up activities.
